Kinematic Bone Traversal

Discovers head, neck, leftArm, rightArm, and hands using flexible regex matching that supports both standard and Mixamo bone naming conventions.

Delta Exponential Lerp

Updates rotation every frame using smoothness = 1 - Math.exp(-5 * delta), guaranteeing silky smooth gestures regardless of refresh rate (60Hz, 120Hz, or 144Hz).

Directional Left Pointing

When the cursor hovers over or explores the left-side text cards, the astronaut coordinates head yaw, pitch, and arm elevation to dynamically spotlight and explain the information.
